status-effects-compendium.Name: Empty condition list
status-effects-compendium.Hint: Fills an empty Conditions compendium with the system conditions, restoring the token HUD conditions. Compendiums with content are never changed.

encumbered-status-sync.Name: Overloaded when adding or removing items
encumbered-status-sync.Hint: Updates Overloaded (Sobrecarregado) as soon as items are added to or removed from the sheet, without duplicating the condition.

ongoing-damage-conditions.Name: Per-turn damage of Em Chamas and Sangrando
ongoing-damage-conditions.Hint: At the start of the turn, a creature that is Em Chamas (on fire) rolls 1d6 fire damage to chat. A creature that is Sangrando (bleeding) rolls a Constitution test (DC 15): on a success the condition ends; on a failure it rolls the loss of 1d6 HP. Damage is applied from the chat, like the system's ongoing damage. Before, these conditions never dealt damage.

prone-defense.Name: Prone (Caído) Defense
prone-defense.Hint: Prone (Caído) adds −5 to Defense instead of replacing the sheet's Other (Outros) field with −5. The manual bonus is kept, and repeated copies of Prone do not stack.

condition-skill-lists.Name: Skills missing from conditions
condition-skill-lists.Hint: Blinded, Weakened and Debilitated now penalize Thievery, and Frustrated and Dispirited penalize the Crafts. Every character skill whose key attribute the condition names, custom skills included, gets the same penalty.

death-threshold.Name: Minimum HP (death threshold)
death-threshold.Hint: A character dies at −10 HP or at minus half their maximum HP, whichever is lower. Applies to player characters, threats and GM characters.

Floor.Name: HP below the death threshold
Floor.Hint: Applies to creatures covered by the "Zero HP states" rule. Allow going below: damage may take HP below the threshold (−10 or minus half the maximum HP, whichever is lower), and the creature becomes Dead (Morto) on reaching or passing it. Clamp at the threshold: damage stops at the minimum HP. With "Zero HP states" off, damage stays clamped.

armor-penalty-reduction.Name: Upgrades that reduce armor penalty
armor-penalty-reduction.Hint: Ajustada, Sob Medida and Mitral reduce the armor penalty (down to 0) instead of increasing it.

finesse-agile-weapons.Name: Weapon Finesse with agile weapons
finesse-agile-weapons.Hint: Acuidade com Arma and the optional rule Armas Leves e Ágeis now use Dexterity for attacks and "Padrão" damage with agile weapons (Florete, Cimitarra, Katana, Chicote, Corrente de Espinhos), as they already did with light weapons.

spell-dc-bonus.Name: Spell DC bonuses
spell-dc-bonus.Hint: Spell DCs now include the character's "Spell DC" effects, the DC bonus of NPC items and usage effects, and Fortalecimento Arcano as a passive bonus (+1, or +2 with 4th-circle spells).

threatening-crit-range.Name: Ameaçadora threat range
threatening-crit-range.Hint: The Ameaçadora (keen) enchantment now doubles the weapon's threat range (long sword 19 → 17) before effects that increase it. Before, the weapon could no longer score critical hits.

alchemical-damage-bonus.Name: Alchemical damage bonus
alchemical-damage-bonus.Hint: "Alchemical damage" bonuses (modificadores.dano.alq) are now added to the damage of alchemical items, such as Fogo alquímico, even without a spell damage bonus.

hide-legacy-upgrades.Name: Hide legacy upgrades ("Deprecated")
hide-legacy-upgrades.Hint: Hides the "Deprecated" block from the item sheet Enhancements tab; its fields do not work. No data is changed.

item-effects-on-actor-sheet.Name: Item effects on the actor sheet
item-effects-on-actor-sheet.Hint: Lists effects coming from items on the actor sheet, where they can be toggled, edited, deleted and dragged.

usage-effect-toggle.Name: Usage effects "Always Apply" toggle
usage-effect-toggle.Hint: The usage effect toggle switches "Always Apply" on and off, and the icon shows its state.

conditional-powers.Name: Equipment-conditional powers
conditional-powers.Hint: Two-Handed Style (Estilo de Duas Mãos), One-Weapon Style (Estilo de Uma Arma), Weapon and Shield Style (Estilo de Arma e Escudo), Armored (Encouraçado, including the +2 from Fanatic and Impregnable) and Impregnable (Inexpugnável) are suppressed when the equipment does not meet the power's condition. Fanatic (Fanático) now ignores the −3 m from heavy armor.

modified-fields-filter.Name: Effects worth 3 or 4 in the breakdown
modified-fields-filter.Hint: Effects that add exactly 3 or 4 (for example Defesa +3) show up again in the breakdown shown when hovering the sheet values, and the breakdown total matches the sheet again.

field-bonuses-breakdown.Name: PV, PM, skill and Defesa breakdowns
field-bonuses-breakdown.Hint: The breakdown shown when hovering PV, PM, skills and Defesa matches the sheet value: manual per-level bonuses are multiplied and the manual total is listed, formulas such as 2+1 are evaluated, Override and Multiply effects are shown as the system applies them, effects with * appear on every skill, the attribute capped by heavy armor is listed and, on the Defesa, each "Other" and condition effect is listed by name (conditions that do not stack are dimmed).

field-bonuses-tooltip.Name: Token and Defesa breakdowns
field-bonuses-tooltip.Hint: The breakdown shown when hovering the sheet values uses the unlinked token's own data (it showed the base actor's) and the Defesa breakdown lists the penalty of conditions (Desprevenido, Cego, Enredado…).

attribute-breakdown.Name: Attribute breakdown
attribute-breakdown.Hint: Hovering an attribute on the sheet shows where its value comes from: base, racial, temporary bonus and each item, spell, power or effect by name, like PV, PM, Defesa and skills already do.

suppressed-usage-effects.Name: Usage effects of unequipped items
suppressed-usage-effects.Hint: Usage effects of unequipped weapons and equipment are no longer offered or applied on rolls.

appended-usage-changes.Name: Changes appended by usage effects
appended-usage-changes.Hint: Usage effects that append a bonus to another effect (such as Inspiração Marcial) are added only once and no longer alter the original effect between uses.

linked-usage-effects.Name: Linked effects from another item
linked-usage-effects.Hint: Usage effects that deliver an effect stored in another item (such as Arte Mágica and Esgrima Mágica on Inspiração) now add it to the chat card, without mixing changes.

usage-buff-templates.Name: Spell, power and item buffs
usage-buff-templates.Hint: Buffs such as Arma Mágica, Óleo de Arma Mágica, Duelo and Botas Aladas become chat card buttons. Once applied, they work on rolls by themselves, and the weapon buff asks for the chosen weapon.

temporary-usage-effect-expiry.Name: Temporary usage effects expiry
temporary-usage-effect-expiry.Hint: Temporary usage effects expire at scene end, by rounds or by time advancement, like other effects.

ability-dialog-cost.Name: Total cost in the usage dialog
ability-dialog-cost.Hint: "Total Mana Cost" adds the base cost and the checked enhancements, without double counting. Display only.

spell-cost-zero.Name: Spell cost zeroed by a false cantrip
spell-cost-zero.Hint: −1 PM reductions set to "Always Apply" and 0-cost enhancements no longer turn the spell into a Cantrip (0 PM). With Cantrip checked, the other enhancements are unavailable.

segmented-scene-setting.Name: Segmented Scene setting
segmented-scene-setting.Hint: Removes the broken "Segmented Scene" row (console error) and adds a button in the Tormenta20 tab to configure the rule.

rest-recovery.Name: Prolonged care on rest
rest-recovery.Hint: In the Rest dialog, Prolonged Care (Cuidados Prolongados) adds +1 HP per level to the recovery, as in the Cura skill, instead of doubling all recovered HP.

menace-xp-fraction.Name: XP of threats with fractional CR
menace-xp-fraction.Hint: Threats of CR 1/4 and 1/2 are worth 250 and 500 XP (CR × 1,000) instead of 1,000 XP.

save-skill-bonus.Name: Skill (except attack) bonuses on saves
save-skill-bonus.Hint: Fortitude, Reflexos and Vontade get "Testes de Perícias, exceto de Ataque" bonuses even when the character also has "Testes de Perícias de Resistências" bonuses. Before, the latter cancelled the former.

sheet-initiative-token.Name: Initiative rolled from the sheet goes to the right combatant
sheet-initiative-token.Hint: Rolling Initiative from the sheet or a macro writes the result to that token's combatant, even with several unlinked tokens of the same actor, and also when the skill label was renamed or translated by another module. Before, the result went to the first token of the same actor and, with a label other than "Iniciativa", never reached the tracker.

initial-class.Name: Initial class with multiclassing
initial-class.Hint: Keeps a single initial class. Marking, unmarking or deleting a class, or bringing a class from another sheet, no longer moves or duplicates the mark that decides 1st-level HP.

initiative-tiebreak.Name: Initiative tie-break
initiative-tiebreak.Hint: When two combatants roll the same Initiative result, the one with the higher Initiative skill at the time of the roll acts first, as the rulebook says. If the skill also ties, the one with the higher value in the skill's attribute (Dexterity by default) acts first. The order holds for the whole combat. Before, the tie was decided at random.

skill-modifier-attributes.Name: Temporary attribute bonuses in global modifiers
skill-modifier-attributes.Hint: Global skill, attribute, damage and healing modifiers that use an attribute (such as the @car of Aura Sagrada or the @con of Trincado) now use the attribute with its temporary bonuses (items, spells, potions), on the sheet and on rolls, as the breakdown already showed. PV and PM still ignore those bonuses.

spell-compendium-data.Name: Spell compendium data
spell-compendium-data.Hint: Fixes, without saving anything, spell enhancements that diverge from the rulebook: Curar Ferimentos cantrip (1d8 light damage), Sono, Raio do Enfraquecimento, Arma Mágica and the multiple-application flag (Físico/Mente Divina, Queda Suave and others). Edited effects are left untouched.

enchantment-data.Name: Upgrade, material and enchantment data
enchantment-data.Hint: Guardião, Protetor, Relampejante, Sombrio, Mitral and Incandescente now apply to the character; Gelo Eterno, Adamante, Invulnerável, Delicada and Discreto follow the book; heavy Mitral armor allows up to 2 Dexterity and Mitral items take 1 less space; Manto da Resistência is created enabled.

race-data.Name: Race data
race-data.Hint: When the copy is created in the world, corrects races and racial powers that diverge from the core rulebook: Minotauro (Con +1 instead of Dex +1), Hynne's Pequeno e Rechonchudo (Small, 6m), Anão's Conhecimento das Rochas (darkvision) and Elfo's Sentidos Élficos (low-light vision). Acts only on system compendium copies that still hold the original data. Characters and items already created are not changed: on the sheet, a warning icon marks the old copy, which must be removed and added again to receive the corrected data. Turning the fix off does not undo copies already corrected.

racial-attribute-choice.Name: Dynamic racial attributes
racial-attribute-choice.Hint: In the Atributos Dinâmicos dialog of Humano, Sereia/Tritão, Lefou and Osteon (+1 in three different attributes), replaces the free number inputs with +1 buttons: exactly three different attributes, the others locked once three are chosen, and Apply only with three choices. Closing without applying shows a warning. Races with another description and the open races mode keep the original dialog.

partner-combatant.Name: Combatente partner
partner-combatant.Hint: When the copy is created in the world, the Combatente partner's usage effects give +2, +3 and +4 to attack (Iniciante, Veterano and Mestre), as in the core rulebook and the item description, instead of +1, +2 and +3. Each effect changes only if it still holds the original system compendium data. Items already created are not changed: on the sheet, a warning icon marks the old copy, which must be removed and added again (or have its effects edited). Turning the fix off does not undo copies already corrected.

engenhoqueiro-armor-penalty.Name: Engenhoqueiro without armor penalty
engenhoqueiro-armor-penalty.Hint: Ofício (Engenhoqueiro) no longer takes the armor penalty, like the other Ofícios in the core rulebook. Applies to every character, including those already created, and nothing is saved: turning the fix off restores the system behavior.

bestiary-creature-type.Name: Threat creature type
bestiary-creature-type.Hint: When the copy is created in the world, Zumbi, Esqueleto, Esqueleto de Elite, Turba Zumbi, Falange, Aparição and Vampiro become Undead, and Finntroll Caçador, Finntroll Feitor, Cultista da Traição and Enxame Kobold become Monster, as in the core rulebook, keeping their subtype. Only copies from the system compendium that still hold the original type and subtype are changed. The statblock importer reads type, size and role in the rulebook spelling ("Morto-vivo"), case-insensitively, and only corrects what the original importer did not read. Threats already created are not changed, and turning the fix off does not undo copies already corrected.

PartnerCombatant.Outdated: Copy created with the wrong attack effects of the system compendium (+1/+2/+3). Remove it and add it again, or edit the effects to +2/+3/+4 (core rulebook, p. 261).

RaceData.Outdated: Copy created with the wrong data of the system compendium. Remove it and add it again to receive the corrected data (core rulebook).

RacialAttributes.Skipped: Racial attributes not applied: the race was created without the +1 to three attributes. Adjust the racial attributes on the sheet.

ItemEffects.DeleteContent: Delete the effect {effect} from the item {item}? This changes the item.

SegmentedScene.Title: Segmented Scene
SegmentedScene.Name: Segmented Scene
SegmentedScene.Hint: Splits each scene into segments. While the rule is active, ending a combat does not end scene effects; the GM advances segments by clicking the circles in the players list (right click goes back). Ending the scene resets the counter.
SegmentedScene.MaxHint: 0 or empty disables the rule. Maximum: {limit} (adjustable in T20CP Center → Optional rules).
SegmentedScene.ValueHint: Between 0 and the number of segments.
SegmentedScene.OverLimit: Segmented Scene: {max} segments exceed the limit of {limit}. Nothing was saved. Use fewer segments or raise the limit in T20CP Center → Optional rules.
SegmentedScene.StoredOverLimit: Segmented Scene: the current configuration has {max} segments, above the limit of {limit}. The players list draws one circle per segment and may become slow. Reduce the segments (Configure Settings → Tormenta20 → Segmented Scene) or raise the limit in T20CP Center → Optional rules.

Limit.Name: Segmented Scene segment limit
Limit.Hint: Maximum number of segments per scene accepted by the Segmented Scene form. The players list draws one circle per segment on every client, so high values may slow down the interface.

SpellCost.Locked: Cantrips cannot be combined with other enhancements.

Sections.suspected-fixed: maybe already fixed by Tormenta20 (still active): {names}
Sections.unverified: not applied on this version (bug not confirmed): {names}

Manager.Name: T20CP Center
Manager.Label: T20CP Center
Manager.Hint: Tormenta20 bug fixes and the module's optional rules, in one window.
Manager.Title: T20CP Center
Manager.PendingReload: Reload the world to apply the changes.
Manager.Switch: On: applied while the bug exists. Off: not applied.
Manager.ForceContent: These patches will be applied even if the diagnosis says Tormenta20 already fixed the bug. If the system did fix it, the behavior may be doubled (for example, two Encumbered conditions). Continue?

applied.Label: Applied
applied.Hint: The bug exists on this version; the patch is active.

applied-unverified.Label: Applied (unverified version)
applied-unverified.Hint: Version {reason} is unverified, but the bug was detected; the patch is active.

disabled.Label: Off
disabled.Hint: Patch turned off in the T20CP Center.

fixed.Label: Fixed in the system — can be turned off
fixed.Hint: {reason} already fixes the bug. The patch was not applied on this load and your preference was kept; you can turn it off.

unverified.Label: Unverified version
unverified.Hint: The bug could not be confirmed on {reason}. The patch was not applied on this load and your preference was kept; check "Apply always" if the bug persists.

error.Label: Error
error.Hint: Failed to apply: {reason}. Check the console (F12).

suspected-fixed.Label: Possibly fixed — review
suspected-fixed.Hint: There are signs that {reason} fixed the bug, but the check does not cover the whole patch. It stays active; check the behavior without it before turning it off.

applied-guarded.Label: Applied as a precaution
applied-guarded.Hint: Version {reason} is unverified and the bug cannot be checked at load time. The patch stays active and only acts when the bug shows up.

forced.Label: Forced
forced.Hint: Applied by your choice, regardless of the diagnosis.

disabled-fixed.Label: Off · fixed in the system
disabled-fixed.Hint: {reason} already fixes the bug; the patch can stay off.

Setting.Name: Mana limit per use
Setting.Hint: Optional rule from the book: a use cannot spend more mana than the level in the class that grants the ability (or the character level for race, origin, general and granted powers). The minimum cost is always allowed. Warn shows a warning and lets the use go on; Block stops the use, unless the source of the limit is unknown. Each item's limit can be set in the "Mana limit per use" field of the item sheet.

ManaLimit.Exceeded: {name}: this use costs {cost} MP, above the limit of {limit} MP per use ({source}).
ManaLimit.Blocked: Use blocked: reduce the enhancements or use the minimum cost ({minimum} MP).
ManaLimit.Unknown: The source of the limit is unknown, so the use is not blocked. Fill in the "Mana limit per use" field on the item sheet.
ManaLimit.FieldHint: Optional rule from the Tormenta20 Community Patches module. Empty: automatic (level in the power's class or character level). "none": no limit. Or a dice-free formula, such as @nvl.arcanista or @nivel.

Setting.Name: Usage effect maximum applications
Setting.Hint: Optional rule: each usage effect may have a maximum number of applications per use, given by a formula (for example, the Bard's Inspiration increase: +1 every four levels). Warn shows a warning and lets the use go on; Block keeps the dialog open until the applications respect the maximum. Each effect's maximum can be set in the "Maximum applications" field of the effect's Use tab.

UsageEffectMax.FieldHint: Optional rule from the Tormenta20 Community Patches module. Empty: module default. "none": no limit. Or an integer ≥ 0 or a dice-free formula, such as floor((@nvl.bardo - 1) / 4). An invalid formula does not limit.

Setting.Name: Effects of the same ability
Setting.Hint: Optional rule (chapter 5, "Acumulando Efeitos"): effects of the same ability do not stack on the target. Applies to effects applied from the chat card when using a power (class, race and origin abilities, and powers), such as the Bard's Inspiration, even from different characters. Replace the previous: the new effect removes the previous one. Keep the greater: the greater bonus stays; a new effect that is not greater is refused. Spells, items and effects applied before this module version do not take part.

SameAbility.Refused: {actor} already has an equal or greater "{effect}" effect; the new effect was not applied. Effects of the same ability do not stack ({reference}).
SameAbility.Replaced: The previous "{effect}" effect on {actor} was replaced by the newest one. Effects of the same ability do not stack ({reference}).
SameAbility.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Acumulando Efeitos", p. 232

Setting.Name: Item and spell bonuses
Setting.Hint: Optional rule (chapter 5, "Acumulando Efeitos"): effects of items do not stack with other items, nor spells with other spells; different sources still add up. For each statistic, the greatest bonus and the greatest penalty of each source apply; the others are suppressed, never deleted, and apply again when the greater one ends. The equipped armor and shield always add to Defense; among the other items, only the one with the greatest Defense counts. Abilities, conditions and effects applied by macros or dragged onto the sheet do not take part.

SourceStacking.Suppressed: {loser}: {stat} {value} does not apply to {actor}; {winner} ({winnerValue}) applies instead. {reason} ({reference}).
SourceStacking.Tooltip: Suppressed by the "Item and spell bonuses" rule:
SourceStacking.Accessory: Besides the armor and the shield, only one item adds Defense and armor penalty

Category.magia: Spell bonuses do not stack with each other
Category.item: Item bonuses do not stack with each other

SourceStacking.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Acumulando Efeitos", p. 232

Setting.Name: Effective item values
Setting.Hint: Shows on items the final value after upgrades, materials and enchantments. In Effective item mode, a module that writes item data back may save the final value as the base.
Setting.effective: Effective item (other modules read the final value)

ItemEffectiveStats.PolishedNote: the book limits it to the 1st round of combat (Tormenta20, p. 166)
ItemEffectiveStats.PenaltyFixOff: Reduction treated as a penalty by the system; enable the armor-penalty-reduction fix
ItemEffectiveStats.ThreatFixOff: Threat range {value}: the weapon never crits; enable the threatening-crit-range fix

Setting.Name: One sustained spell at a time
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (p. 227): you can keep several sustained abilities, but only one sustained spell; two with the Fluxo de Mana power (p. 38). Warn shows a warning when casting or applying a sustained spell beyond the limit, and when applying a card from a superseded cast. Nothing is ended automatically: end the spell from the sheet or from the "Sustentar Efeitos" card. Sustained abilities (powers) do not count.

Sustained.Warning: {actor} {held} (limit: {capacity}). When casting {item}, end a sustained spell: ending is a free action ({reference}).
Sustained.Uncertain: has markers that may belong to a spell (check the sheet): {markers}
Sustained.Stale: This {spell} card comes from a superseded cast: after it, {actor} cast {current} (limit: {capacity}). Check before applying ({reference}).
Sustained.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, "Duração", p. 227; "Fluxo de Mana", p. 38

Setting.Name: Conditions that prevent spells
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (p. 394-395 and 170): Atordoado, Fascinado, Pasmo and Surpreendido cannot take actions, but can react (p. 233); Inconsciente and Petrificado cannot even react; Paralisado only takes mental actions and cannot gesture or speak, unless with Magia Discreta. Applies to spells and scrolls. Warn shows a warning (recommended); Block stops the use before the dialog, without spending MP. When an enhancement changes the execution (for example, Campo de Força as a reaction), Atordoado, Fascinado, Pasmo and Surpreendido are checked when the use dialog is confirmed.

Conditions.Subtle: {actor} has Magia Discreta: with the enhancement, the spell can be cast even while Paralisado. Check with the GM.
Conditions.Reaction: Under this condition, only a reaction is allowed: choose an enhancement that turns the spell into a reaction.
Conditions.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, Appendix, "Lista de Condições", p. 394-395; ch. 4, "Gestos e Palavras", p. 170

Setting.Name: Concentration in a bad condition
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (p. 170): casting a spell while Caído or Surdo requires a Vontade test (DC 15 + MP spent). Warn posts the DC to the chat after the card. The test is rolled from the sheet.

Concentration.Message: Concentration: {actor} casts {item} in a bad condition ({conditions}). Vontade test DC {dc}; on a failure, the spell is lost, but the MP are spent ({reference}).
Concentration.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 4, "Concentração", p. 170

Setting.Name: Non-proficiency penalties
Setting.Hint: Characters take −5 on attacks with weapons they are not proficient with, and the armor penalty of armor or shields they are not proficient with applies to every Strength and Dexterity skill (core book, p. 142 and 152). Proficiencies come from the initial class, recognized powers and the Traits tab. Choices (Proficiência, Balística, Abençoar Arma) must be marked on the Traits tab; until then, affected items show a warning and are not penalized. Threats are not affected.

NonProficiency.Armor: Not proficient: {penalty} armor penalty on Strength and Dexterity skills
NonProficiency.Pending: Undetermined proficiency ({sources}): mark the choice on the Traits tab. No penalty until then
NonProficiency.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 3, p. 142 and 152
NonProficiency.UnknownSource: Non-proficiency penalties: the system code changed ({methods}). Check whether Tormenta20 already applies these penalties, so they are not doubled.

OngoingDamage.TestPassed: {name}: Constitution test (DC {dc}). Success: the condition was removed.

Setting.Name: Saving throw from the chat card
Setting.Hint: Adds to the card of spells and abilities with a saving throw a button for each target to roll Fortitude, Reflexes or Will against the DC. The card shows who passed, who failed and the book effect (negates, partial, half).

SaveButton.Title: Saving throw
SaveButton.NoTargets: No targets. Select the tokens and use the button below.
SaveButton.NoSelection: Select one or more of your tokens.
SaveButton.RollFailed: Could not roll the saving throw. See the console.
SaveButton.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Testes de Resistência", p. 227

Effect.anula: The ability has no effect on a target that passes its saving throw.
Effect.parcial: The effect is lesser on a target that passes the saving throw.
Effect.metade: The effect is halved on a target that passes the saving throw.
Effect.desacredita: Realizes the illusion is not real. The illusion keeps working; this creature may warn its allies as a free action, letting them test to disbelieve.
Effect.evita: A target that passes the test avoids the effect.

Setting.Name: Attack versus Defense
Setting.Hint: Optional rule (chapter 5, "Attack Test" and "Critical Hits"): compares each item's attack test with the Defense of every target marked when rolling and shows on the card whether it hit or missed. A natural 20 always hits and a natural 1 always misses. A critical only counts on a hit: when the attack misses every target, the damage is not multiplied. Against a prone target, ranged attacks use Defense +5 instead of -5. Foes' Defense follows the system setting "Show foes DC to players". Without marked targets, nothing changes.

AttackVsDefense.CriticalCancelled: No critical hit: the attack missed every target.
AttackVsDefense.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Attack Test" and "Critical Hits", p. 230-231

Setting.Name: Concealment miss chance
Setting.Hint: Optional rule (chapter 5, "Situações Especiais", p. 238-239): light concealment gives a 20% miss chance and total concealment 50%, rolled on 1d10 together with the attack's d20. The attack dialog gets the "Target concealment" field, and the card shows the 1d10 and the verdict for each target marked when the use started. Blind on the attacker and Invisible on the target are detected as total concealment. If the d20 threatens a critical and the attack misses every target by concealment, the critical is cancelled.

Dialog.Label: Target concealment
Dialog.Hint: Darkvision only ignores the total concealment of non-magical darkness, not invisibility.
Dialog.PreviewNone: Automatic: no concealment detected on the targets.

Card.Title: Miss chance
Card.CriticalCancelled: No critical hit: the attack missed every target.
Card.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Situações Especiais", p. 238-239

UsageBuffTemplates.Prompt: Choose the weapon of {actor} that receives {effect}.

Setting.Name: Trained-only skills
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (chapter 2, "Treinamento e testes", p. 114): skills marked "trained" can only be used by characters trained in them. Warn lets the roll happen and marks the card; Block stops the test unless the character uses an ability that grants training for the test (Eclético, Cultura Exótica). Only characters are checked.

TrainedOnly.Untrained: {actor} is not trained in {skill}, a trained-only skill.
TrainedOnly.OpenDialog: Open the usage dialog and check {grants}.
TrainedOnly.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, chapter 2, "Treinamento e testes", p. 114

Setting.Name: Skill choice
Setting.Hint: Optional rule: when Treinamento em Perícia, Versátil, Híbrido, Memória Póstuma, Conhecimento Enciclopédico or Educação Privilegiada is added to a character, asks which skills become trained and stores the training as effects of the power. Removing the power removes the training.
Setting.on: Ask when the power is added

SkillPicker.Title: {item}: skill choice
SkillPicker.Prompt: Choose {count} skill(s) in which {actor} becomes trained.
SkillPicker.PromptRange: Choose {min} to {max} skills in which {actor} becomes trained.
SkillPicker.Cancelled: {item}: no skill was chosen. Mark the training on the sheet, in edit mode.
SkillPicker.NoSkills: {item}: {actor} is already trained in (or has just chosen, in another power of the same batch) every skill this power can grant.
SkillPicker.Stale: {item}: a chosen skill has just become trained (another user changed the sheet). Choose again.
SkillPicker.Waiting: {actor}: waiting for another skill choice for this character to finish.
SkillPicker.Alternative: {item}: {count} of {max} skills chosen. Add what you received instead to the sheet (for example, a general power).

Setting.Name: Situational modifiers
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (ch. 5, Table 5-3, p. 239; "Charge", p. 235; "Ranged attack", p. 233): the attack dialog gets boxes for flanking, charge, higher ground, firing into melee and double range, which go into the roll with a label, and, per target, for light cover and invisible attacker, which adjust the target's Defense in the "Attack versus Defense" rule or appear as a note on the card. A charge gives the attacker a −2 Defense effect, which must be deleted by hand at the start of their next turn. In the resistance test of a maneuver, only "higher ground" is shown.

Defense.invisible: Does not perceive you, invisible (−5 Defense)

Tooltip.flank: Melee only: you and an ally are on opposite sides of the target. Not ranged nor unarmed (unless you have Brawl or Unarmed Style). Tormenta20 JdA, p. 239.
Tooltip.charge: Melee only: move up to twice your speed (at least 3m) in a straight line and attack. You take −2 Defense until your next turn; the "Charge (guard down)" effect is applied and must be deleted by hand. Tormenta20 JdA, p. 235.
Tooltip.elevated: You are higher than the target. Tormenta20 JdA, Table 5-3, p. 239.
Tooltip.firingIntoMelee: Ranged only: the target is within the natural reach of an enemy (including you). Precise Shot cancels this penalty: uncheck it. Tormenta20 JdA, p. 233.
Tooltip.longRange: Ranged only: the target is beyond the weapon's range, up to double. Tormenta20 JdA, p. 233.
Tooltip.cover: Something between you and the target blocks the attack (tree, wall, wagon, larger creature): +5 to the target's Defense. A target with total cover cannot be attacked. Tormenta20 JdA, p. 239.
Tooltip.invisible: The target does not perceive you, invisible: −5 to the target's Defense. Uncheck it for targets that perceive you. Tormenta20 JdA, Table 5-3, p. 239.

ChargeEffect.Name: Charge (guard down)
ChargeEffect.Description: −2 Defense until your next turn; delete this effect at the start of your next turn (Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Investida", p. 235).

SituationalModifiers.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, Table 5-3, p. 239

Setting.Name: Nonlethal damage
Setting.Hint: Core rulebook rule (ch. 5, "Wounds & Death", p. 236): a "Nonlethal" button next to the apply damage buttons makes 1x, 2x and ½ apply nonlethal damage. HP lost this way are kept in the sheet's "Nonlethal" field, count toward falling unconscious but not toward bleeding or dying, and healing recovers them first. Raising the field on the sheet applies the difference as nonlethal damage. With the rule off, healing still consumes the nonlethal HP already recorded.

NonlethalDamage.Tooltip: Nonlethal damage: while this button is pressed, 1x, 2x and ½ apply the damage as nonlethal.
NonlethalDamage.NoTokens: Select one or more tokens to apply the nonlethal damage.
NonlethalDamage.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 5, "Wounds & Death", p. 236

Setting.Name: Arcane spells in armor
Setting.Hint: Optional book rule (ch. 4, "Armaduras e Magia Arcana", p. 171): casting an arcane spell while wearing armor requires a Mysticism test (DC 20 + the spell's PM) with the armor penalty. On a failure the spell does not work, but the PM are spent. Characters only. Bards in light armor, Magia Discreta and items with the waiver skip the test.

ArcaneArmor.FailureManual: Failure: {spell} does not work, but its {cost} PM are lost. Automatic PM spending is off: deduct them on the sheet.
ArcaneArmor.Untrained: {actor} is not trained in Mysticism, a trained-only skill: the test cannot be made.
ArcaneArmor.UntrainedHint: To use {grants} in the armor test, turn on "Aplicar Sempre" in its effect.
ArcaneArmor.GrantUsedManual: Used {grant}: deduct {cost} PM on the sheet (automatic PM spending is off).
ArcaneArmor.Ambiguous: {spell}: ambiguous source for arcane armor (the character has classes with different armor rules). The Mysticism test was not made; set "Casting (arcane armor)" on the spell sheet.
ArcaneArmor.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, ch. 4, "Armaduras e Magia Arcana", p. 171

SpellField.Hint: How this spell is cast, for the "Arcane spells in armor" rule. Automatic infers it from the character's classes (Arcanista: arcane; Bardo: bard arcane; Clérigo and Druida: no test).

WaiverField.Hint: This item waives the Mysticism test of the "Arcane spells in armor" rule (for example, Conjurador Encouraçado).

Setting.Name: Combat maneuvers
Setting.Hint: Book rule (ch. 5, "Combat Maneuvers", p. 234; "Overrun", p. 233): in the use dialog of a melee attack, choose the maneuver (grapple, trip, disarm, shove, sunder or overrun) against the single targeted creature. The attack roll becomes the maneuver test: damage is not rolled and the maneuver card replaces the attack card. The target's owner (the GM, for NPCs) clicks Resist and rolls their own test with a melee weapon (or Fight); the module adds size, breaks ties by the book and creates the result card. The result follows the resister's roll mode: in "Public", everyone sees the NPC's numbers; to hide them, resist in "GM Roll". The condition (Prone, Grappled) is not applied: apply it from the token HUD. Two nearly simultaneous clicks may create two results; the oldest one counts.

ButtonSetting.Name: Maneuver button in chat
ButtonSetting.Hint: Also shows the Maneuver button on the card of a melee attack already rolled, to declare the maneuver after the attack. When off, the maneuver is declared only in the use dialog.

Dialog.Title: Combat maneuver
Dialog.OtherHint: Balanced and the maneuver powers (Improved Trip, Ground Fighter…) go in the attack dialog; do not repeat them here.
Dialog.NoWeaponHint: With Fight (no weapon), maneuver powers and other attack effects are not part of the test: add them in Other modifiers.

Setting.Name: Creature type traits
Setting.Hint: Book rule (chapter 7, "Tipos de Criaturas", p. 284) for creatures whose Type is Undead or Construct (and characters with Natureza Esquelética): fatigue, metabolic and poison conditions (and darkness, for undead) are suppressed; darkness damage heals undead; "Apply Healing" with HP healing asks whether it is light damage (full or half) on an undead and recovers no HP on constructs.

CreatureTypeTraits.Immune: {actor}: {condition} has no effect. {kind} are immune to {category} effects ({reference}).
CreatureTypeTraits.ImmuneCondition: {actor}: {condition} has no effect. {kind} are immune to this condition ({reference}).
CreatureTypeTraits.ConstructNoHeal: {actor}: constructs do not recover HP from healing effects ({reference}).

Dialog.Title: Healing an undead: {actor}
Dialog.Content: {actor} is undead. Magical light healing effects damage undead (a Will save against the effect's DC halves it). How should the {amount} HP of healing apply?

CreatureTypeTraits.Reference: Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, cap. 7, "Tipos de Criaturas", p. 284

Setting.Name: Zero HP states
Setting.Hint: Optional rule (chapter 5, "Ferimentos & Morte"): at 0 HP or less, a creature becomes Unconscious (Inconsciente) and Bleeding (Sangrando); any healing of 1 HP or more removes Bleeding, and reaching 1 HP or more removes Unconscious; losing more HP at 0 or less makes it bleed again; at the death threshold (−10 or minus half the maximum HP, whichever is lower) it becomes Dead (Morto). Only conditions applied by this rule are removed automatically. Nonlethal damage (when that rule is on) knocks out, but does not cause bleeding or death. The Bleeding Constitution test is not rolled here.

Setting.Name: Encounter rewards
Setting.Hint: GM tool to award encounter XP (CR × 1,000 per defeated challenge, split among the characters; Tormenta20 Jogo do Ano, p. 326). GM button: a button in the token controls. Button and on combat end: the dialog also opens when a combat ends. Only the active GM awards. Treasure is not generated: the summary says where to roll it.

Modes.encounter: By encounter CR (Ameaças de Arton, p. 376)
